t: A full Linux computer tucked inside a compact keyboard.
steps: Buy the Raspberry Pi 400 Personal Computer Kit from a maker shop such as Adafruit.
Unpack the keyboard, mouse, power supply, microSD card, and micro-HDMI cable.
Slide the microSD card into the slot on the back.
Connect the cable to a TV or monitor and plug in the mouse.
Plug in power and follow the setup screens to join Wi-Fi.
Open Thonny from the Programming menu.
Try the first Python project in the Beginner's Guide.
meta: Open Code. From $60. Easy to find.
